swaps: The author proposed no swap. None proposed by the refuter: the five picks and flagships stand.
tension: The Library's Jim Beam calls the house the largest bourbon producer on earth and the birthplace of the premium category, and its Behind the bar line speaks of a bargain: superlative, unsourced and price words the house voice refuses.
The Library's Buffalo Trace gives est. 1773 site and calls it America's oldest continuously operating distillery: the brand's claim, not used here; the record's year is the 1999 release.
The Library's Wild Turkey gives a barrel entry proof of 115, which no source of the author or refuter confirmed.
The distillery's own pages give the Stagg name as 1904 in one place and 1907 in another; this repo's shelf records say 1904, as the record does.
